title: OpponentSheet
description: The opponent sheet block (ADR-027 section 2; ADR-025 erratum E4): per opponent preview slot, in preview order, what the player's own view makes probable about the slot's brought status, item, ability, nature and moves, as integers in parts per million. A derived input beside the observation, built only from the player's own view (closed regime: from the opponent belief's marginals). Reader rules (the profile has no if/then): the source kind fits the regime; entries are sorted by ppm descending then id ascending (a null item id last) with unique ids; other_ppm is max(0, 1000000 - sum of the entries) and the sum is at most 1000000 plus one per entry (each entry is rounded alone); a field of source unknown has no entries and other_ppm 0; a field of source revealed holds its one value at 1000000 ppm (moves: slots_known is 4 and the first four entries are at 1000000); a refused block (source.refusal present) has every slot unknown with brought_ppm 0.

slots.description: One per opponent preview slot, in preview order.

SheetSource.description: Where the block comes from. kind: engine-sheet (the open regime), belief (the opponent belief at the request), revealed-only (no predictor) or oracle-diagnostic (test-only); hash is the SHA-256 naming the block's identity (for belief: the feature set hash, which names the belief identity, the k values and the rounding). refusal is present exactly when the belief was refused: a fixed code, and every field of the block is then unknown.

species.description: The preview species id (for orientation: the observation already shows it).

brought_ppm.description: P(the slot is among the Pokemon brought), round half up of the exact rational.

SheetFieldSource.description: revealed (seen in battle, 1000000 ppm), predicted (the belief), sheet (an engine-sent sheet, open regime only) or unknown (no support or no predictor).

SheetItemField.description: Item: at most k entries (k item 4 in the first feature set), id null meaning no item; other_ppm is the rest.

SheetIdField.description: Ability or nature: at most k entries (k ability 3, k nature 3), other_ppm the rest.

SheetMoveField.description: Moves: at most k entries (k moves 8) with the move's inclusion probability (each move alone, not a share of one total) and slots_known, the number of the four move slots the view has revealed (0 to 4).
